articles.summary: The Vaca Muerta shale formation in Neuquén, Argentina, continues to unlock new opportunities while raising the bar for what the local energy industry needs. For Tenaris, the answer lies in staying close to its customers, combining experience across different markets, and translating that knowledge into products and services tailored to local operational needs.
articles.title: Tenaris shares its Vaca Muerta vision at the Shale in Argentina event in Houston

articles.summary: Tenaris will host a series of technical and industry-focused panel discussions at ROG.e 2026 (Rio Oil & Gas Expo and Conference), one of the leading oil and gas events in Latin America, taking place in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
articles.title: Industry leaders join Tenaris for technical panels at ROG.e 2026

articles.summary: Originally from Ipatinga, in the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais, Bárbara Emerick Dias' industrial connection began early. Growing up near a steel facility and watching her father's work in the manufacturing sector helped spark her interest in engineering.
articles.title: The resilience behind an engineer's rise from trainee to Operations Manager at Tenaris
